title: 美伊协议主导G7峰会 欧洲领导人松一口气 特朗普议程成焦点
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Well, let's talk about what the feeling is this morning.
segments.zh: 我们来聊聊今早的市场情绪。

segments.en: A sigh of relief may be, particularly from Europeans, when it comes to the fact that this deal has now been done.
segments.zh: 尤其是欧洲方面，可能会松一口气，因为协议终于达成了。

segments.en: Yeah, I think a sigh of relief is certainly the predominant feeling here for the G7 leaders that will be assembling an EVO into me with Donald Trump.
segments.zh: 是的，对于即将与特朗普会面的G7领导人来说，松一口气无疑是主要情绪。

segments.en: I think they're very excited about the deal. I think they'd love to hear what's in the deal and how actually it's going to be arbitrated, what are all the different details?
segments.zh: 他们对协议非常兴奋，想了解协议内容、仲裁方式以及所有细节。

segments.en: Of course, I will be the prominent discussion between the group of seven leaders, but of course, Guy will also be joined here by the leaders of the UAE Qatar and Egypt, who will have a very active role in enforcing
segments.zh: 这将是G7领导人讨论的重点，此外阿联酋、卡塔尔和埃及的领导人也将参与，他们在协议执行中扮演重要角色。

segments.en: and deliberating over the architecture of whatever is contained within this deal going forward.
segments.zh: 他们将共同审议并执行协议中的架构安排。

segments.en: There is also a small European dimension to this deal. There are sanctions that are on Iran from the Europeans.
segments.zh: 协议还有欧洲维度：欧洲对伊朗有制裁。

segments.en: We had a statement from the EU for the UK, Germany, France, and Italy saying that they were welcoming the deal and that they were open to wave or diminish
segments.zh: 欧盟、英国、德国、法国和意大利发表声明，欢迎协议，并愿意在协议条款得到执行后，放宽或取消部分制裁。

segments.en: some of their very own sanctions if some of these things that have been agreed to in this deal over the monitoring period of time are actually enforced.
segments.zh: 如果协议中的监测条款得到落实，他们愿意放宽或取消自己的制裁。

segments.en: And we've heard from the very beginning, from the host of this meeting, from Emmanuel Macron, the president of France, that the Europeans and the French would take an active role
segments.zh: 会议东道主、法国总统马克龙从一开始就表示，欧洲和法国将发挥积极作用。

segments.en: the day after, militarily in the straight of Hormuz, potentially on efforts of demining.
segments.zh: 次日，在霍尔木兹海峡的军事行动，可能涉及排雷工作。

segments.en: This is something that we've heard repeatedly from the Europeans. So this is an opportunity to offer some of these things to Donald Trump.
segments.zh: 这是欧洲方面反复提及的。因此，这是一个向特朗普提供这些提议的机会。

segments.en: And of course, the big question will be, what is Donald Trump's agenda coming into this?
segments.zh: 当然，关键问题是特朗普此次参会的目的何在？
